comment: Xiaomi 13 (fuxi) GPU firmware the kernel embeds in place of the reference board's. A740 is the shared SM8550 GPU, so the SQE microcode and the GMU image should be the ones this phone actually runs; only the ZAP shader is device-locked, because TrustZone (PAS) authenticates its vendor signature. Fill bytes and sha256 from scripts/pull-fuxi-gpu-firmware.sh; no file here enters the repository. While a sha256 is null the kernel carries an empty image and the GPU stops at that step, which is the correct failure to see before the rest of the GPU path exists.

qcom/sm8550/fuxi/a740_zap.mbn.source: HyperOS 4.0.0.12.XMCCNXM vendor /firmware/a740_zap.mdt + .b00-.b02, pulled with adb on 2026-11-14 (world readable; root was available but not needed) and joined by scripts/squash-mdt.py into a 12088-byte 32-bit ELF with three segments at offsets 0/4096/8192
qcom/sm8550/fuxi/a740_zap.mbn.note: the same size the OnePlus Ace 3 port pins for its own A740 ZAP, so the shader is shared and only the signature differs

qcom/sm8550/fuxi/gmu_gen70200.bin.source: vendor /firmware/gmu_gen70200.bin, pulled 2026-11-14; the file is named after the GMU generation, not after the GPU, so a search for a740_gmu.bin finds nothing on this device

runtime_reference.stock_identity: ro.serialno a3130473; persist /dev/block/sda18 (64 MiB), devinfo /dev/block/sda15 (16 MiB); ro.boot.chip_id is empty on this build
runtime_reference.stock_input: fts at event7 (FocalTech touch), gpio-keys event0, pmic_pwrkey event1, goodix uinput event2
runtime_reference.wifi: Qualcomm kiwi / kiwi_v2 (WCN7850 class): /vendor/firmware/wlan/qca_cld/kiwi{, _v2} hold WCNSS_qcom_cfg.ini and a wlan_mac.bin link into /mnt/vendor/persist
runtime_reference.framebuffer: there is no /sys/class/graphics/fb0 on this build: the stock kernel drives the panel through msm_drm, so no fbdev mode string exists to match
runtime_reference.dtbo: dtbo_a is a Qualcomm DTBO table (DT_TABLE_MAGIC 0xd7b7ab1e) on /dev/block/sde18, 25165824 bytes with 57 overlay DTBs; the overlays the bootloader applied are already merged into the live tree that facts/gpu_memory_facts.json summarises, and the resolved panel is qcom,mdss_dsi_m3_38_0c_0a_dsc_cmd
